Our platform puts expert knowledge at your fingertips, reducing the need for costly callouts while improving equipment reliability.
about_page.story_p3: Today, we work with fitness operators of all sizes - from single-site independent gyms to large leisure centre chains. Our focus remains the same: delivering practical, cost-effective solutions that make a real difference to your operations.
about_page.subtitle: We're on a mission to transform gym maintenance with AI-powered solutions that save time, reduce costs, and keep equipment running smoothly.

pulse_pricing.faq_a1: Yes. Every module — Operations, CRM, Marketing and Memberships — is a standalone subscription. Start with one and add more whenever you need them.
pulse_pricing.faq_a2: Lite is the free equipment portal included with every Pulse Fitness service agreement. Managed adds AI diagnostics and reporting handled by your account manager. The modules are the full self-serve software platform for running your gym.
pulse_pricing.faq_a3: Yes — pricing is shown and billed in GBP, EUR or USD. We auto-detect your region and you can switch currency at any time.
pulse_pricing.faq_a4: Every module comes with a 14-day free trial. No card is required to start, and you can cancel anytime.
pulse_pricing.faq_a5: Absolutely. Annual billing saves you roughly 17% versus monthly, and you can change your billing cycle whenever suits you.
pulse_pricing.faq_a6: Your data stays yours. Export it any time, and nothing is deleted the moment you cancel — you keep read access during your notice period.
